Document containing only HTML comments produces empty output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<!-- This is a comment --><!-- Another comment -->", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
